name: io.github.kinti/a11y-toolkit
title: A11Y Toolkit
description: The accessibility layer for AI coding agents: express static WCAG 2.2 audit, rendered audit (computed contrast, 2.5.8 target size, focus indicator), exact contrast math (pairs, CSS names, hsl/rgba, text-over-image pixel sampling), EAA/RD 1112/2018 accessibility statements, snapshot regression diffs and an aria-live monitor. Zero dependencies at core; es/en.
